lines.t: I'm so tired, glass eyes, in a blue lit room
Deadlines, diapers, dollar signs, all bloom
Bench press pain just to feel my pulse
Council on speed, dial playlist full
Bible on the nightstand, but my heart on mute
Medicated feelings in a tailored suit
Scroll through noise just to dodge your voice
I'm drowning in a sea of my own choice
I've been hiding in the mirror and the things I do
But the cracks in my reflection all look like you
So serve me, oh God, strip the shadows from my soul
Burn my paper, then control, make this broken spirit whole
I don't know you like I say, I don't know myself at all
Yahushua, see it all, catch me when I finally fall
Yeah, what, yeah
Late nights, coating culture in my veins, no drip
Therapy talk but I still backslide, lose grip
Church lights, stained glass, but the hurt don't pass
Smile for the fam while the hours bleed fast
Stack vows like bricks, I'll never be weak
Built walls so high, I can't hear you speak
Holiday idols, bow to the shopping mall
False Jesus on the cards, but my heart's stonewalled
Then it hits in the mirror, knees cut by the floor
All my self-made crowns rolling out the door
I don't know you, God, I don't know me
Just a lost stress son who forgot how to see
And you're coming waves in the wreckage in the night
Binding up my open wounds in the cold phone light
Every error that I made starts flashing in my eyes
Every grievance that I've done, every heart I've sliced
Yet I'm held, yet I'm loved in the middle of the proof
You surround my shame with a circle of truth
I'm safe to spill the secrets, I was scared to confess
I agree with every word you speak over this mess
I'm convicted, not condemned, guilty yet I'm free
Pardoned by the blood that was poured out for me
Kindness of the Lord pulling tears from the stone
This is not self-effort, I'm not striving alone
alone, it's a holy partnership, you showed up to deliver, your mercy on my tongue, your fire in my
liver, now I'm quick to say you're right when you cut, cause every time you break me, you're the one
lifting me up, so search me, oh God, strip the shadows from my soul, burn my paper, then control,
make this broken spirit whole, I don't know you like I said, but now I hear your call, yeah,
Yahushua, in my fall, you're the hands beneath it all
So search me, oh God, strip the shadows from my soul
Burn my paper, then control, make this broken spirit whole
I don't know you like I said, but now I hear your call
Yahushua, in my fall, you're the hands beneath it all
Broken but I'm found In your arms I finally see
It's your kindness, not my trying That's delivering me
Thanks for watching guys!
